payout_quote: We'll match your opening deposit up to $300! Bonus is a matching opening deposit up to $300 for new Premium Checking Accounts. Account requirements: Debit Card (at least one transaction per month over first 60 days), eStatements and recurring monthly Direct Deposit totaling $500 or more. Opening deposit match (up to $300) will take place approximately 60 days from opening date. Offer expires September 30, 2026.
steps: Open the account before September 30, 2026 (the offer expires that day)
Join OUR Credit Union (membership open to people who live in Michigan and other membership qualifiers) and open a new Premium Checking account
Deposit your opening deposit - OUR will match it dollar-for-dollar up to $300 (deposit $300 to get the full $300 match)
Within the first 60 days: make at least one debit card transaction per month, enroll in eStatements, and set up a recurring monthly direct deposit totaling $500 or more
The matching deposit (up to $300) is credited approximately 60 days from the opening date
catches: Offer EXPIRES September 30, 2026 - only 7 days after verification (2026-09-23)
The 'bonus' matches YOUR OWN deposit - you must deposit up to $300 of your own money (kept in your checking, fully withdrawable) to earn the full match
Not available if you have an existing OUR checking account or closed one within the previous 12 months
Cannot be combined with any other OUR Credit Union offer
Bonus-tracking sources report a hard pull for account opening
